skills.description:
对话交接——一个对话聊久了，一键把进度写成「交接单」存到本地；下次开新对话，说一句「接着上次」就能调出来继续干，不用从头再讲一遍。双模式：说「写交接单」「保存进度」就存，说「接着上次」「上次聊到哪了」就取。同一件事多次交接会自动串成一条线。

Session handoff for long conversations: save a structured handoff note locally, then restore it in a fresh session to continue where you left off. Dual mode: save ("write a handoff", "save progress") and restore ("continue from last time", "where did we leave off"). Multiple handoffs on the same topic are chained into one thread.
Trigger: /grace-handoff, "write a handoff", "save progress", "continue from last time", "where did we leave off"
